nodes.title: 03 · Save · Original pixels / FPS / mosaic kept
READ ME · Sound-only postprocessing
widgets_values:
AUDIO IMAGE ONLY: wan22-v9-ltxaudio-cu130 / AUDIO_PROFILE=dragonleap-v4
Finish WAN generation (including RIFE, upscale, mosaic), save the MP4, then upload it here.
No WAN re-generation. The saver stream-copies the ORIGINAL video and REPLACES its audio.
One H.264/H.265 MP4, up to 7 seconds. Same duration, resolution and FPS; output is a NEW file.
Describe audible events and their visible timing, not just the picture. Seed stays fixed for comparison.
reference_max_side reduces ONLY the conditioning copy. 640 default; 512/384 reduce audio inference memory.
refine_audio ON: 8+4+2 steps / CFG1 / euler_cfg_pp / linear_quadratic. OFF: 8-step trial, quality may differ.
CFG1 ignores negatives. State No speech / No music in the positive prompt if needed; not guaranteed.
edge_fade_ms=20 reduces boundary clicks; a perceptually seamless sound loop is NOT guaranteed.
Uses the exact DragonLeap V4 INT8 ConvRot + Gemma / projection / VAEs from ltx23-i2v-runpod.
This NEW frozen-video mode is experimental, NOT official Foley and NOT the original joint-video workflow.
Additional models: 44.98 GB. CUDA13-compatible host driver required. GPU quality/speed not validated by CPU CI.
